reviews.review_description:
Got an early copy of this game , and have a couple leftvto do, I am really enjoying the journey so far, beautiful settings and such a calming relaxing experience.
The puzzles themselves are really clever, I’m confident enough not you use the manual now.
The hut is a cosy place to sit back and chill.
Thank you to dev for providing a key I throughly recommend this app.

Puzzles of the world is a wonderful and relaxing experience. I own several puzzle games on the quest but the devs did a great job in creating something unique. You follow the building instructions in your own pace, the scenery is beautiful and the feeling to "get something done" make the experience rewarding and fun. 

I just finished a few models and can't wait to finish some more. A great cozy app to relax.

reviews.review_title: needs table adjustments to lay down mode
reviews.review_description:
Can yout please make the Option to move the play table up higher , as I am unable to move to a sit up straight position, 
I am able to do this in almost all the other games and puzzles i subscribe too and I feel others also would like the lay down and relax mode. 
I will more than likely own ever puzzle you ever release, but I really really need this Playing field adjustable Please.
Thank you
